title: legend_spec v2 (ADR-0152)
description: Canonical thematic legend contract, v2 = v1 (ADR-0078 discriminated union) + additive provenance fields: k, palette_id, clip_policy, why, nodata_label, out_of_range_label, out_of_range. Frontend lines 06 (paint projection), 07 (legend rendering) and 09 (self-healing actions from SymbologyDecision.rejected[]) consume this schema. SCHEMA FROZEN at AC-03 merge: additive-only evolution after freeze.

type.description: Discriminant (ADR-0078). bivariate/uncertainty_opacity exist in-code but are emitted by their own builders and out of scope for v2 freeze.

palette_colors.description: Resolved hex colors (single resolution path: resolve_thematic_colors).

method.description: Classification method used (v1 field; v2 keeps semantics, engine fills when adjudicated).

context.description: v2: PaletteContext the decision was adjudicated for. When print, palette_colors are already desaturated (rendering requirement) — consumers must not re-transform.

unit.description: v2: unit of the thematic field (empty string when unknown).

k.description: v2: class count actually emitted (graduated: len(breaks)-1; categorical: len(categories)). Adjudicated k is clamped to [3,7] by resolve_symbology except degenerate/constant data.

palette_id.description: v2: canonical palette id chosen by resolve_symbology (echoes palette).

clip_policy.description: v2: outlier/domain policy applied before classification. Any non-none policy MUST be disclosed by out_of_range / method semantics — silent clipping is forbidden.

why.description: v2: human-readable adjudication summary (SymbologyDecision.why(); ';'-joined reasons). Empty string when no decision evidence available.

nodata_label.description: v2: legend label for the no-data swatch.

out_of_range_label.description: v2: legend label for clipped tail; empty when clip_policy == none.

out_of_range.description: v2: present ONLY when clip_p99 actually clipped values. Rendered values above `upper` show `color` (top class).
